title: Which Wish Did the AI Write?

texts.a: Happy 80th, Ammamma! Still remember you running behind my cycle, holding the seat. Keep the pulihora ready, coming at 7!
texts.b: Happy 80th birthday, Grandma! Thank you for teaching me to ride a bicycle all those years ago. Your pulihora is still the best in the family, and I miss you dearly. Wishing you a day filled with love and joy! 🎉🎂
texts.of: Of course! Here's a sweet birthday wish for your grandmother:

lines.text: Ammamma turns eighty. Both grandsons live next door. [1] One typed his wish for ten minutes. One tapped an AI.
lines.show: Ammamma turns 80. Both grandsons live next door. One typed his wish for 10 minutes. One tapped an AI.

lines.text: Which one did the AI write? [1] One, or two?
lines.show: Which one did the AI write? One, or two?

lines.text: Two. [1] "I miss you dearly"... from next door?
lines.show: Two. "I miss you dearly"... from next door?

lines.text: The AI used both real details. [1] Then it guessed the rest.
lines.show: The AI used both real details. Then it guessed the rest.

lines.text: We tested a small free AI on our laptop, not ChatGPT. With no details, ten tries: [1] all ten said "May this special day". One even began, "Of course! Here's a sweet birthday wish".

lines.text: With the two details, it used both, every time. [1] But five times, it guessed "I miss you".

lines.text: So tell it the facts that matter, [1] read every line, and fix what isn't true.
lines.show: So tell it the facts that matter, read every line, and fix what isn't true.

lines.text: Ammamma's reply: [1] "Miss me? You're ten steps away. Come and eat!"
